description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveAcl class, which represents a command to retrieve Access Control List (ACL) information for a specific Thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class includes methods for creating instances from JSON, specifying resource paths, and managing headers, and it contains metadata annotations indicating deprecation and immutability.

classes.name: RetrieveAcl
classes.description: An immutable, deprecated command class that retrieves ACLs for a specified Thing, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, header management, and resource path specification within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveAcl command with a ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveAcl command from a JSON string or object, parsing necessary fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing this ACL retrieval command targets.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON path resource for ACL retrieval.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with different headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the schema versions supported by this command (only V_1).
